audit.whatIsWrong: win[] and phases[].side marked levels 2-3 as Akali's and both item stages as Akali's, contradicting the prose which calls 2-3 even and both item stages Gwen's.
audit.why: At 2-3 Akali has no shroud and Gwen has no Mist - genuinely even. From Riftmaker/Nashor's, %-max-HP Snip Snip! plus A Thousand Cuts healing wins the extended duel Akali cannot refuse in a side lane.
audit.corrected: Skill / Skill / Skill / Akali / Akali / Gwen / Gwen.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike and phase text never gave a cooldown, so 'hold Mist for her all-in' had no timing anchor.
audit.why: Shuriken Flip is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10 and Twilight Shroud 20/19/18/17/16, against Hallowed Mist at 22/21/20/19/18 - she gets more entries than Gwen gets answers, and that is the shape of the mid game.
audit.corrected: mid, whys[1], whys[6] and phases[1].why now carry the real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Akali's Assassin's Mark auto-attack reset was never mentioned, and the full layer wrongly called Twilight Shroud untargetability.
audit.why: Assassin's Mark (P) carries the autoReset flag - the reset wind-up, not the Shuriken Flip cast, is the tell that the burst is starting. Twilight Shroud has no untargetable flag and Riot's text describes a concealing cloud; calling it untargetable would tell a player their Mist timing is safe when it is not.
audit.corrected: early now names the Assassin's Mark reset as the step-back cue; dosFull[0].d corrected to invisibility that breaks targeting.

audit.whatIsWrong: Trading rules and Do's referred to Akali as 'he'.
audit.why: Template copy; on a page whose job is trust, a wrong pronoun reads as a wrong matchup.
audit.corrected: tradeGood and tradeBad rewritten for Akali specifically.

edits.before: Neither of us wants the level 1-2 fight here — she has energy and a Q shuriken poke pattern but no shroud untargetability yet, and I am a clunky cone with Mist on a long early cooldown, so just stack Snip Snip! on the wave and tag her with the true-damage center snip if she creeps into melee to last-hit. edits.after: Neither of you wants the level 1-2 fight here — she has energy and a Q shuriken poke pattern but no shroud yet, and you are a clunky cone with Mist on a 22s cooldown, so stack Snip Snip! on the wave and tag her with the true-damage center snip if she creeps into melee to last-hit. With Q+E at three you can poke-and-reset, but her Q out-ranges your cone, so never chase a snip she can sidestep. Her burst opens on an Assassin's Mark auto reset — that wind-up is your cue to step back, not the E cast. Track her energy and do not fall behind.

edits.before: This is her window, not mine. At 6 I have the full Q-W-E-R kit, but a fed Akali's R two-cast dash can still execute me before Mist matters; only commit when her Twilight Shroud is down and I have Skip 'n Slash up to dash out of her reset. Bank CS, dodge the empowered Q, and survive to my item.
edits.after: This is her window, not yours. She pokes with Q shuriken from outside your cone, then E-marks in for the Q-AA burst the instant your Hallowed Mist is on cooldown — hold Mist for her all-in instead of bleeding it on trades, and farm at max snip range. At 6 you have the full kit, but Shuriken Flip is 16s at rank 1 against your 22s Mist, so she gets more entries than you get answers; commit only when Twilight Shroud is down and Skip 'n Slash is up to dash out of her reset. Bank CS, dodge the empowered Q, survive to your item.

edits.before: Once Riftmaker (or Nashor's into Riftmaker) completes, the lane flips to me — %-HP Snip plus Hallowed Mist lets me win the extended duel, and standing on top of her in melee means her Twilight Shroud only breaks targeting briefly while I keep auto-snipping and healing off the damage through the cloud. Skip 'n Slash refunds on every champion hit, so I can chase her dashes. Force every fight on her shroud cooldown here. But Akali is a hard scaler too: past two items her item burst and R execute window can blow me up between Mist drops, so close it out at my spike rather than gambling on the very late 1v1.
edits.after: Once Riftmaker (or Nashor's into Riftmaker) completes, the lane flips to you — %-HP Snip plus Hallowed Mist wins the extended duel, and standing on top of her in melee means Twilight Shroud only breaks targeting while you keep auto-snipping and healing off the damage through the cloud. Skip 'n Slash refunds part of its cooldown on every champion hit, so you can chase her dashes. Force every fight on her 20s shroud. But Akali scales too: past two items her item burst and R execute window can blow you up between Mist drops, so close it out at your spike rather than gambling on the very late 1v1.

notes: Two systemic problems here. (1) The whole content block for this matchup is written in FIRST person ('I am a clunky cone', 'my Hallowed Mist', 'execute me') - everywhere else Gwen's pages use second person. Converted early, mid, late and all seven whys. (2) content win[] disagreed with its own whys at four of seven stages and with the full-layer phases; both now match the prose (Skill/Skill/Skill/Akali/Akali/Gwen/Gwen). Also: the full layer says Akali is 'Untargetable inside' Twilight Shroud - she is invisible, not untargetable, and the content layer already had it right ('breaks targeting'); corrected. tradeGood/tradeBad/dosFull used 'he turns' for Akali. Suspect names 'Use Twilight Shroud' and 'Snip Snip' are false positives (text already correct); 'Thousand Cuts' was genuinely missing its 'A' and is fixed in two places.
